parsed.estimand: Odds ratio of a red card per game comparing skin tone 1 (darkest) with skin tone 0 (lightest), estimated on player-referee dyads.

steps.title: Measure skin tone
steps.description: Two raters scored each player photo, 0 very light to 1 very dark.

options.label: Mean of both raters
options.rationale: Averaging two blind raters reduces rating noise.
options.spec: skin_tone = mean(rater1, rater2); missing if either is missing.
options.source: Silberzahn et al. (2018), Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science

options.label: Rater 1 only
options.rationale: A single rater avoids mixing two scoring styles.

options.label: Rater 2 only
options.rationale: Rater 2 scored darker on average, so this is the mirror check.

options.label: Clearly light or clearly dark
options.rationale: Dropping ambiguous mid-scale players sharpens the contrast.
options.spec: Keep players whose mean rating is <= 0.25 or >= 0.75.

steps.title: Choose which dyads to keep
steps.description: Dyads are player-referee pairs; some players have no photo rating.

options.label: Rated players only
options.rationale: Skin tone is undefined without both ratings.

options.label: Rated players, referees with 22+ dyads
options.rationale: Referees seen in few dyads add noisy rates.
options.spec: Drop unrated rows, then referees with fewer than 22 dyads.

steps.title: Adjust for context
steps.description: Decide which player and league attributes enter the model.

options.label: No covariates
options.rationale: The raw contrast answers the question as asked.

options.label: Height, weight, position
options.rationale: Defenders and heavier players are fouled and carded more.

options.label: Physique plus league country
options.rationale: Leagues differ in how strictly red cards are given.

steps.title: Fit the model
steps.description: Estimate the odds ratio of a red card per game.

options.label: Binomial GLM
options.rationale: Red cards out of games is a binomial outcome.
options.spec: GLM Binomial on (redCards, games - redCards); OR = exp(coef).

options.label: Poisson GLM with log-games offset
options.rationale: Red cards are rare counts over exposure.
options.spec: GLM Poisson with offset log(games); reports the rate ratio.

options.label: Binomial GLM, player-clustered errors
options.rationale: A player appears in many dyads, so rows are not independent.
options.spec: Binomial GLM with cluster-robust standard errors by player.
